hits.title: Xometry Announces CEO Succession and Board Leadership Changes - The Globe and Mail
hits.snippet: Xometry announced on February 24, 2026, that its board approved a leadership transition effective July 1, 2026, elevating President Sanjeev Singh Sahni to chief executive officer and adding him to the board as a Class I director, while expanding the board from six to seven members to accommodate ... Xometry announced on February 24, 2026, that its board approved a leadership transition effective July 1, 2026, elevating President Sanjeev Singh Sahni to chief executive officer and adding him to the board as a Class I director, while expanding the board from six to seven members to accommodate his appointment. The company also detailed that current CEO Randolph Altschuler will step down from that role on July 1, 2026, to become executive chair for an indefinite term, and that current board chair Fabio Rosati will shift to lead independent director, moves that collectively reshape governance while keeping key leaders in influential positions.
